name: Dual Taste
description: Taste hostile qi and hostile soul force together to learn which would feed the user better.

name: Joined Siphon
description: Siphon the qi and the soul force of one strike together into a single reserve.

name: Twofold Soak
description: Soak the qi of a blow into the body and its soul force into the soul at once.

name: Transmuted Qi
description: Turn the qi drawn from a hostile technique into soul force and store it in the soul.

name: Coupled Rebound
description: Rebound a mixed qi and soul strike with both halves of its force drawn into the return.

name: Dual Purge
description: Draw a poison from an ally's body and a curse from its soul in one pass and burn both for fuel.

name: Doubled Drain
description: Drain qi from the body of a target and force from its soul until both run thin.

name: Unison Intake
description: Take hostile qi and soul force in together and settle both as a single fuel.

name: Twinned Lash
description: Lash a target with stored qi on its body and stored soul force on its soul in one stroke.

name: Dual Absorption
description: Absorb a hostile attack that carries both qi and soul force and keep every part of it.

name: Twinfold Reservoir
description: streams: Soul + Qi; draw hostile qi and soul force into one reservoir and spend it as a blow on body and soul together.

name: Joined Tally
description: Tally at the Core how much force the body and the soul could each take from a foe.

name: Core Siphon
description: Siphon hostile force straight to the Core where body and soul both draw on it.

name: Shell Cover
description: Set a shell of Core qi over a veil of soul force so a blow must breach both.

name: Sunk Pull
description: Sink a pull into a target's Core and thin the force that feeds its body and soul.

name: Dual Conversion
description: Convert drawn qi and drawn soul force at the Core into whichever the next technique needs.

name: Core Rebound
description: Rebound a strike from the Core with its qi and soul force both turned on the striker.

name: Whole Cleansing
description: Draw a deviation backlash from an ally's body and the erosion from its soul at the Core.

name: Flesh Lash
description: Lash a target's body with stored qi and its soul with converted force in one stroke.

name: Unified Reservoir
description: Hold one reservoir at the Core that stores qi and soul force as a single fuel.

name: Wide Return
description: Return the joined store in a wide wave that strikes the body and soul of every foe near.

name: Whole Rebound
description: Rebound a heavy blow with all the force the Core can draw from it added to the return.

name: Whole Absorption
description: Absorb an attack on body and soul together at the Core and convert all of it.

name: Marrow Convergence
description: streams: Soul + Body; draw hostile force into the body and the soul together and spend it as one blow from the Core.

name: Triune Draw
description: streams: Soul + Qi; pull every hostile force in range through the Core and settle it as one great store.
